input: A policyholder reports water damage after a burst pipe in the kitchen. The incident happened yesterday and they have photos of the damage.
actual_output: This should be triaged as a property claim. Request policy number, incident date, photos, repair estimate and confirm whether emergency mitigation was required.
expected_output: Classify as property claim, request incident date, policy number, photos, repair estimate and flag for coverage review if exclusions may apply.

input: A claimant reports stolen business equipment from a locked van overnight. They have filed a police report.
actual_output: This appears to be a theft claim. Request policy details, police report reference, list of stolen items, purchase invoices and circumstances of the loss.
expected_output: Classify as theft/property claim, request police report, itemised loss list, proof of ownership, policy details and check security conditions.

input: A customer says they want to claim for a cancelled trip because they changed their mind about travelling.
actual_output: This should be reviewed carefully as it may not be covered. Request policy wording, reason for cancellation, booking documents and any supporting evidence.
expected_output: Classify as travel cancellation claim, flag potential coverage issue, request booking documents, cancellation reason, policy wording and supporting evidence.
